# Toolbox

> What we use, by job. Brand names live in the password manager, not here.

- Notes: a markdown vault synced with git.
- Design: a vector editor shared with Ada.
- Invoices: the accounting app, numbering per [[invoice-numbering]].
- Backups: nightly copy to an external disk.
